picks.title: Castelion hits $13B valuation to mass-produce hypersonic missiles
picks.why_it_matters: A 2022-founded defense startup reaching $13B valuation signals continued massive appetite for dual-use deep tech and validates the defense/aerospace vertical as a category where early-stage VCs can find outsized returns.

picks.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
picks.why_it_matters: Explosive growth in AI training data infrastructure reveals a picks-and-shovels opportunity layer where startups can build defensible businesses serving the insatiable data needs of foundation model companies.

picks.title: Early Cerebras investor Adit Singh joins Mayfield as infrastructure partner
